summary: Independently re-derive GATE-2 (compact projectable action subspace) and Phase-4 leakage, and audit the Phase-6A causal-negative for artifacts.

gate2.notes:
Independent re-derivation in /tmp (no action_latent import). Confirmed data facts myself: 160-clip cache = concat[train(120);val(40)]; keys/shapes as stated; W_env columns orthonormal (|G-I|<5e-7); stored e exactly equals (hn@W_env) with hn=(h-mean)/std (max diff 0.0); h_res = hn - (hn@W_env)@W_env.T is orthogonal to W_env (max|h_res.W_env|=1.8e-6). Split = 112/24/24 into [train;val] order; shift 0 -> all 48 frames; train-only standardization; pooled variance-weighted R2.

Re-derived Gate-2 by re-implementing the pipeline math from scratch (regularized generalized-eigenvalue CCA with ridge=1.0 added to Sigma/M-scaled covariances; NIPALS PLS; ridge decoder with val-selected lambda):
- CCA d=4 -> u=h_res@W -> ridge -> TEST R2 = 0.893660 (reported 0.8936514, target ~0.894). My from-scratch CCA subspace matches the stored W_act_sup_chosen with principal-angle cosines [1,1,1,1] (exact recovery), and its mean/std/W_env match the decomposition file exactly.
- PLS d=16 -> TEST R2 = 0.933241 (reported 0.9331210, target ~0.933); PA_cos_min vs stored pls_d16 = 1.0.
- matched random d=4: best 0.2496, mean 0.185 over 8 seeds (reported single-seed random 0.0235); PCA d=4 = 0.662045 (reported 0.6620313). CCA(0.894) beats the strongest matched-d=4 baseline (PCA 0.662) by 0.232 and random by >0.64 -> beats_baselines=True.
- e->a ridge TEST R2 = 0.506105 (reported 0.5062784). Paired clip-bootstrap gain = R2(cca_d4)-R2(e) = 0.3876, 95% CI (0.289,0.520), robustly excludes 0 across bootstrap seeds {1,7,42,2024} (lower bound ~0.29; min gain over 10k resamples ~0.20). Reported gain 0.3874, CI (0.257,0.560).
- Also reproduced PLS d=4 = 0.84605 (reported 0.84604) using stored W as a cross-check.

ADVERSARIAL CAVEAT (does not change the verdict but worth flagging): the headline CCA=0.894 is implementation-sensitive. A textbook/under-regularized generalized-eigenvalue CCA (PCA-whitening, val-selected component count) only reaches 0.69-0.835, and sklearn 1.6.1 CCA degenerates to ~-0.09 at p=2048 (x_rotations_ collapse). The 0.894 is recoverable ONLY with the pipeline's specific regularization (ridge=1.0 on Sigma/M, applied to RAW h_res with no re-standardization). Given that exact recipe it reproduces to 5-6 decimals, but the number should be understood as method-dependent, not a robust property of any CCA. PLS d=16 and e->a are far less sensitive and reproduce cleanly. best_matched_random_d4_r2 reported here is my best-over-8-seeds (0.2496), conservative; the pipeline's single-seed value (0.0235) is even lower. All targets in phase2/linear_metrics.json reproduced.

leakage.notes: Independently re-derived in /tmp/verify_taskb*.py (no action_latent import). Data confirmed: cache = concat[train(120);val(40)]=160 clips; split_metadata indexes into [train;val] (sizes 112/24/24, NOT 120/40 as the prompt stated). Provided subspace mean/std differ slightly from a train-only recompute (max|dmean|=0.099, max|dstd|=0.062) i.e. they are GLOBAL stats not strictly train-only; I used the provided mean/std per spec (hn=(h-mean)/std), h_res=hn-(hn@W_env)@W_env.T. Refit CCA-d4 on TRAIN between h_res and actions via whitening+SVD (canonical corrs 0.995/0.994/0.989/0.975, all <=1); u=h_res@W_cca4. CONTINUOUS: ridge u->e (lambda val-tuned) TEST aggregate R^2=-0.044, bootstrap-test-clip 95% CI [-0.142,-0.056] -> firmly <0.1, env-free. full standardized-h->e R^2=0.9996 (~1.0). random-16-dims-of-h_res->e mean R^2=0.011 over 10 seeds (slightly below the ~0.04 target but same near-zero ballpark). Note: 'full h_res->e' would be ~0 since h_res is orthogonal to W_env; e is reconstructed from full standardized h (=hn@W_env), hence ~1.0 reported. DISCRETE: my own LBFGS multinomial logreg (val-tuned C) u->suite TEST acc=0.2865 vs majority chance 0.25; bootstrap 95% CI [0.194,0.376] straddles chance (lower bound 0.194 matches the ~0.19 target); P(acc<=chance)=0.23, P(acc<=0.30)=0.61. Decode test is well-powered: full hn->suite=0.996 and env e->suite=0.991, so low u->suite acc reflects genuine near-absence of suite info, not weak probing. VERDICT: chosen_is_clean=True because (R^2 -0.044<0.1) AND (acc 0.2865<=chance+0.05=0.30). Continuous environment-leakage is unambiguously absent. Discrete is the weak link: 0.287>chance 0.25 means a small residual suite signal exists and it only passes by ~0.013 margin with a wide CI overlapping chance. So u is environment-free in the continuous (env-coordinate) sense and effectively so for suite classification, but not provably below chance on the discrete test. My (torch softmax) alternate classifier gave 0.287 consistently; a naive weak-reg CCA initially inflated suite acc to 0.31 and canonical corrs>1 (numerical artifact) — fixed by whitening-based CCA.

audit_6A.concerns:
No artifact found that would invalidate the negative. Verified independently (standalone /tmp scripts, no action_latent import):

(1) W_act_sup_chosen is [2048,4] (CCA d=4), orthonormal to machine precision: ||W^T W - I||_F = 3.7e-9, all col norms = 1.0. It is ~perfectly orthogonal to W_env: ||W_sup^T W_env||_F = 8.8e-8 (random-pair baseline ~0.5), and sup-column energy inside env span is ~2e-15. So the supervised action subspace lives entirely in the env-removed standardized space, the SAME space edits are applied in. sub_mean/sub_std present; W_env, pls_d16, W_act_highfreq also orthonormal. No normalization-space mismatch.

(2) sup_cca4_only delta = +0.12496 (~+0.125), +8.7x original MSE (0.01430 -> 0.13926), all 12 clips strongly positive -> keep-only projection genuinely changes the token-h the head sees. The no_sup_* nulls are therefore NOT a no-op/plumbing bug.

(3) Paired-noise design is sound: original delta_per_clip is identically 0.0 on all 12 clips, confirming per-clip same-seed subtraction so head noise cancels in deltas. n_seeds=10, 12 token clips bootstrapped over clips.

(4) Sign convention delta = cond - original; a causal positive would be large POSITIVE. Observed no_sup_cca4 = -1.9e-4 (null/negative) and MORE negative than matched random (no_random_cca4_d4 = -1.6e-5) -> removing the action dirs hurts LESS than removing random dirs. cca4 sup_minus_random CI includes zero. pls16 no_sup = -2.2e-3 with sup_minus_random excluding zero but NEGATIVE (removal modestly helps). Removing the action subspace never harms the frozen head. Robust null.

(5) 4 dims alone insufficient (keep-only 8.7x MSE) yet also unnecessary (removal ~unchanged): classic redundancy across the remaining ~2044 dims, consistent with the prior tf_latent finding.

Residual caveats (do NOT make it an artifact, but bound the claim): (a) Subspace is tiny (cca4 = 4/2048 = 0.2%, pls16 = 16/2048 = 0.8%), so some insensitivity is expected by dimensionality alone -- but the keep-only positive proves this is genuine redundancy, not an edit that failed to land. (b) The negative is statistically INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM ZERO (no_sup_cca4 mean/SEM over clips ~ -1.59; sup_minus_random CI spans 0 for cca4), so it is more accurately a NULL than a proven-exact-zero; with noise canceled, the across-clip SEM (~1e-4) is the floor and a true ~5e-4 effect would be only borderline-detectable with 12 clips. The intervention.json correctly reports causal_pass=false / any_causal_pass=false and notes this caps the verdict below T1 without negating the correlational+leakage evidence.
audit_6A.verdict: PASS — the Phase-6A causal negative is a genuine, robust null, not an artifact. Projection mechanics are verified (W_act_sup_chosen orthonormal, ~perfectly orthogonal to W_env, applied in the matching standardized env-removed space), and the +0.125 sup_cca4_only delta proves the edit reaches the head. Removing the action subspace does not hurt the frozen head and is not worse than matched-random removal; this is consistent with prior redundancy findings. Only caveat: the effect is statistically indistinguishable from zero (a null rather than a proven-exact-zero), and the subspace is small — but neither undermines the negative, and the report itself appropriately caps the conclusion below T1.
